fusions.name: Bearded Bayonet
fusions.desc: Chops with the blade fixed under your barrel for 5 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds and 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Timber Call
fusions.desc: Fires a heavy round at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 24 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Boarding Action
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds. You finish the move 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Next in Line
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
